toolsPreview.name: lookup_card_price
toolsPreview.description: Get Gembook's fair-value estimate (USD) for a PSA-graded vintage Pokémon card (WotC era, Base Set through Skyridge, 1999–2003). Returns fair value, range, confidence tier, comp count, and the card page URL. Call this when a user asks what a vintage Pokémon card is worth or whether a price is fair. Scope is PSA-graded vintage Pokémon ONLY — other graders, eras, or TCGs are out of scope.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_pop_report
toolsPreview.description: Get the PSA population (number of slabs graded per grade) for a vintage Pokémon card across all grades. Call this when a user asks how rare a PSA grade is for a card. Scope: PSA-graded vintage Pokémon (Base Set through Skyridge).

toolsPreview.name: get_methodology_summary
toolsPreview.description: Returns a short summary of Gembook's valuation + trust methodology (what counts as a verified sale, confidence tiers, published error rates). Call this when a user asks how the prices are computed or whether they can be trusted.
